svg.aria-label: Calculating the transference number: t+ equals Iss times (ΔV minus I0 R0), divided by I0 times (ΔV minus Iss Rss); example about 0.29. Check that t+ is between 0 and 1, that Iss is less than I0, and that the measured and calculated I0 are close. Repeat with 2 to 3 cells.
